results.title: 'Officials will contact': CM Dhami responds to Rishabh Pant's appeal for land
results.description: Rishabh Pant reached out to the Chief Minister of Uttarakhand, Pushkar Singh Dhami, seeking guidance for acquiring land. The Chief Minister pledged government support in line with existing regulations. Pant revealed his intention to construct his first home in his home state, expressing a preference for purchasing land at official rates. Officials will follow up with Pant to ease the land acquisition procedure.
